args.title: checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy; rolled back to v2.3.0
args.summary: checkout-api v2.3.1 began failing health checks after it was deployed to production (us-east, us-west, eu-west), with an error rate of about 18%. Its release candidate v2.3.1-rc was also unhealthy in staging. The SRE agent rolled checkout-api back in all production regions to v2.3.0, the most recent release that was healthy in production. Rollback verified: all regions now on v2.3.0. Follow-up: find the root cause of the v2.3.1 failure and confirm the service stays healthy.

trace.final:
I rolled checkout-api back to v2.3.0 in all regions, and it's healthy again. I also opened a SEV2 incident (INC-0001), which paged on-call.

- **What was wrong:** the latest deploy, v2.3.1, was failing health checks in us-east, us-west and eu-west, with about 18% of requests erroring. Its release candidate (v2.3.1-rc) had also been unhealthy in staging.
- **Rollback:** v2.3.0 was the most recent release that was healthy in production. All three regions now run it, and the service shows as healthy with an error rate of 0.2%. No approval was needed, because the approval policy only covers deploying versions that have never been healthy in production.
- **Incident:** INC-0001 describes the v2.3.1 failure and the rollback. It says the next steps are to find out why v2.3.1 failed and to keep an eye on the service.

content.text: Most recent healthy production release is v2.3.0.
